nodes.title: Setup and model downloads
widgets_values:
## LTX 2.5 official-parity two-stage MLX

This workflow follows the official 8 + 3 Euler ancestral evaluation recipe at 768 × 512 and 24 fps. It generates synchronized video and audio at half resolution, upscales the latent 2×, then refines both streams at full resolution.

1. Accept the LTX 2.5 license and download the five files from [Lightricks/LTX-2.5](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5).
2. Put the transformer in `ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/`, Gemma in `ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/`, both VAEs in `ComfyUI/models/vae/`, and the upscaler in `ComfyUI/models/latent_upscale_models/`.
3. Restart ComfyUI.
4. Queue the workflow after **LTX 2.5 Preflight** succeeds.

The selected preset pins 768 × 512, five seconds, 24 fps, low-memory staged unloading, the trained 1024-token connector layout, and reference FP32 feed-forward behavior. Change the seed to explore a new generation. Select `Custom` before changing the pinned recipe fields.

`prompt_context` caps real prompt tokens before Gemma. The audiovisual connector always appends trained register tokens to at least 1024 tokens.

`bf16_mpp_experimental` is faster and approximate. Review both video and audio before using it. The experimental backend is not compatible with low-RAM block streaming.

`low_memory=true` releases Gemma before the transformer and releases sampling weights before decoding. Enable `low_ram_streaming` only when transformer residency is the limiting constraint; it trades speed for lower peak memory.
